operator_io_quirks: Tiny DB: basketball_match 4 rows, university 5 rows; original_values lists are complete, no rowid sampling needed.
Mixed-case identifiers: Team_ID, School_ID, ACC_Percent, All_Games_Percent, Primary_conference; must be double-quoted in generated SQL.
DDL uses backticks in FK clause (`School_ID` REFERENCES `university`(`School_ID`)) while columns are double-quoted; sqlite_master text must be replayed verbatim.
All_Games_Percent declared INT but storage class is real (0.946, 0.824, ...); declared type dispatches to Number with is_int=True, so TS will emit integers and perturb by +-1/+-2.
Founded and Enrollment declared REAL, storage real, values like 1743.0/19067.0; Number fuzzer with scale from no-args -> default scale, will produce floats far from plausible years/enrollments.
Score columns (ACC_Regular_Season, All_Games, All_Home, ...) are TEXT holding en-dash '14–2' (U+2013), not ASCII hyphen; String fuzzer will not reproduce the dash.
ACC_Percent is TEXT holding '.875' style decimals; String fuzzer treats as generic text, no numeric semantics.
basketball_match.School_ID FK -> university.School_ID, parent PK unique, parent exists; but child values {1,2,4,5} skip 3, so FK coverage is partial in original.
No NOT NULL constraints anywhere (notnull=0 on all columns), so TS's NULL injection will not be rejected by sqlite.
No CHECK constraints, no UNIQUE indexes beyond PKs; drop_unique_duplicates is a no-op here.
No self-references, no composite keys, no dangling FKs, no views/triggers in DDL.
Table order: university (level 0) before basketball_match (level 1) via FK edge; column order within basketball_match puts Team_ID, School_ID first.
operator_ts_expectations: Number fuzzer on Team_ID/School_ID (INT, single-col PK): max_l0=inf, so fresh draws never reused; values spread over [-10^scale,10^scale] with +-1/+-2 perturbation -> implausible team/school ids, likely FN on id-range predicates.
Number fuzzer on All_Games_Percent (INT declared, real stored): is_int=True so emits integers, but original values are 0.6-0.95; any query comparing to a fraction will miss -> FN.
Number fuzzer on Founded/Enrollment (REAL): uniform over huge range, not 1700-2000 or 2000-60000; range predicates on these columns will be wrong -> FN.
String fuzzer on Team_Name/School/Location/Nickname: random a-zA-Z0-9() strings plus contamination; LIKE '%Carolina%' style queries will rarely match -> FN.
String fuzzer on score columns: no en-dash, no 'W-L' shape; queries filtering on '14–2' or splitting on '-' will not fire -> FN.
String fuzzer on ACC_Percent: no leading-dot decimal shape; numeric-looking predicates on this text column will miss -> FN.

FK fill: basketball_match.School_ID drawn from university.School_ID final values with replacement; since university has only 5 rows and PK dedup keeps all, joins will mostly work, but child may reference school ids absent from original -> possible FP on anti-join / NOT IN queries.

choose_table_sizes: with 0.5 prob sizes ~30-230, else level-based (level0 1-31, level1 x4 capped 2500); tiny original (4-5 rows) means TS instances are much larger -> ties/duplicates appear that original lacks, driving FP on DISTINCT/COUNT queries.
PK dedup on Team_ID/School_ID: with max_l0=inf and wide range, collisions rare, so PK uniqueness holds; but if scale small, duplicates dropped -> row counts shrink, affecting COUNT(*) gold.

No NOT NULL: TS may emit NULLs (Base drops None elements but String/Number can still produce them via element pool if originals had none -> actually none here, so NULLs unlikely) -> low NULL-related FP.
No CHECK/UNIQUE: no insert failures expected, so rows_ok == rows attempted; TS quality not degraded by constraint skips here.
Literal pool from train SQL will seed elements like 'Duke', 'ACC', numeric ids; p=0.2 means 20% fresh draws, 80% pool/original -> some plausible values survive, mitigating FN on equality predicates.
